justifications.evidence: every test the done_when names is recorded in the manifest and the gate logs, and the graph test carries a positive control asserting the seeded mapping is visible before the clear (tests/ids/test_mapping_delete_graph.py:99).

justifications.goal_fidelity: both callers now route the whole delete through graph_ops.delete_mapping (imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:808), and the engine branch logs its three counts unconditionally (imas_codex/ids/workers.py:1572).
justifications.reuse: delete_mapping extends clear_mapping_bindings (imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py:827) and replaces the inline evidence-and-mapping delete map.py carried, and a search over imas_codex/ found no other MappingEvidence or IMASMapping delete site.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 24d536235b6..8546ff622 is inside the manifest's declared write paths (imas_codex/ids/graph_ops.py, imas_codex/ids/workers.py, imas_codex/cli/map.py, tests/ids/test_map_run_clear.py, tests/ids/test_mapping_delete_graph.py, docs/evidence/fragments/.../one-mapping-delete-owner.html).

limitations: The reviewed run's gates were not re-run; the added-failure count is read from the reviewed run's own manifest and gate logs, which carry no base/head arm pair.
The graph-marked test needs a live Neo4j and is excluded from the default run, so its end-to-end evidence-delete assertion was read from the reviewed run's gate.log, not re-executed here.
The evidence-delete blast radius on a source shared by two IDS mappings was read from the Cypher and cross-checked against the S19 closing comment, not reproduced against the live graph.
